decisions.executionNote: Raise left arm into elbow-up approach toward the red toy car; gradually orient gripper. Right arm remains home.
Move above the red car with downward gripper and jaws across its width; maintain gradual elbow-up motion.
Descend over red car for a widthwise grasp; verify jaw alignment before closing.
Center jaws on the red car body, close fully, and lift to test retention.
Red car appears retained; carry it above the white basket, reserved for toy vehicles.
Replan with smaller increments after continuity rejection; lower and tilt the held car gently toward the white basket.
Lower the retained red car into the white basket, release, then withdraw upward and back.
Red car is in the white basket. Approach the left gold vehicle with jaws perpendicular to its long axis.
Descend toward the gold tank body, keeping gripper open and checking the final alignment.
Fine-center the tank between the jaws, close, and lift slightly to verify retention.
Tank is retained; carry it to the left side of the white vehicle basket, tilting forward slightly for reach margin.
Tank slipped back onto the table. Reapproach its new position with open jaws and a vertical grasp.
Use wrist view to center the tank body and lower jaws farther around its sides before closing.
Close around the centered tank chassis and lift vertically without rotation to check a deeper grasp.
Tank is visibly held. Carry slowly toward the white basket with constant orientation and closed jaws.
Advance the held tank over the white basket with a slow forward tilt and modest lowering for reach margin.
Release tank into the vehicle basket and retreat. Begin raising the right arm toward the gold van with continuous elbow-up motion.
Withdraw left arm from basket. Bring right gripper above the van and align jaws across its width.
Translate toward the van seen high in the wrist view and lower open jaws toward its body; inspect before gripping.
Grasp the centered van around its sides and lift vertically for a retention check.
Van is retained. Carry it toward a clear center-front staging point for the left arm, without crossing arms.
Continue the closed-gripper van transfer to the center-front tabletop, keeping right EE on its own side.
Set the van down at the center-front transfer area, with a slight inward tip offset while right EE stays on its side; release gently.
Withdraw the right arm to its side while left approaches the staged van from the left, maintaining separation and open jaws.
Lower the left gripper toward the staged van, using a small inward tip tilt while keeping the left EE on its side. Right stays clear.
Fine-align the left fingertips onto the van with an inward tilt, close around its body, and make a small test lift.
Lift the van and move it into the left workspace toward the vehicle basket, keeping the grasp orientation fixed and jaws closed.
Carry the held van toward the white basket. With separation maintained, approach the green watch from the right for the next category.
Van has slipped onto the left tabletop; reopen and reapproach vertically. Simultaneously center the right gripper above the green watch.
Align left jaws across the van now resting on its side. Lower the right jaws around the centered green watch without closing yet.
Fine-center both objects under the jaws, close on the van and green watch, then make small vertical test lifts.
Both objects appear between the jaws. Lift and carry the van toward white and the watch toward blue, maintaining fixed orientation and fully closed commands.
Advance the retained van over white with a modest forward tilt. The watch fell back to the table; reopen and return the right gripper for a deeper grasp.
Release the van inside white and withdraw. Center right jaws around the watch ring and close lower on its sides for a more secure grasp.
Test whether the right watch is retained with a straight lift. Move the open left gripper away from the vehicle basket toward the silver watch.
The green watch now appears retained; carry it toward blue without rotating. Approach the silver watch with the left open gripper as the right moves away.
Center and close left jaws around the silver watch. Bring the securely retained green watch above the blue basket with a slow reach-preserving forward tilt.
Move left outward and lift the silver watch to check retention and clear the right arm. Advance the green watch over the blue interior and release.
Both watches are back on the tabletop. Separate the arms and withdraw the right arm from the basket edge before retrying with a more forward-tilted approach.
After the zero-step continuity rejection, begin the right-arm withdrawal with much smaller increments; separate both open grippers.
Clear the right gripper fully from the basket and central work area. Recenter left jaws nearer the silver watch case and lower for a deeper grasp.
Center on the silver watch case rather than the rear band, lower the jaws farther, close and make a short vertical retention test.
Lift the silver watch and start a gentle forward tilt toward blue. Park the right arm farther out to avoid central interference.
Silver watch was not retained. Reapproach lower with the jaws aimed directly at its solid case instead of pinching the narrow rear band.
The solid watch case is centered between the jaws. Descend slightly farther, close fully, then test with a vertical lift only.
Lift the silver watch clear, then carry toward blue with a slow forward tilt to preserve reach margin. Keep right arm clear.
The silver watch slipped again. Reopen and change the grasp direction substantially to target the solid case instead of the flexible band.
Shift the jaws onto the solid case visible at the right of the band, close with the new grasp direction, and lift vertically for verification.
Test the wider silver-watch grasp with a straight lift, then carry slowly toward blue without changing orientation. Check that the pen is not also retained.
Silver watch remains held and the pen stayed on the table. Advance toward blue with a slow forward tilt to keep the arm short of extension.
Carry the silver watch farther beyond the blue front rim, lower gently and release into the interior; right remains clear.
Silver watch is released inside blue. Withdraw and approach the green watch from the left with open jaws, bringing the grasp axis nearly vertical.
Center the green watch between left jaws using the wrist view and lower around the full watch width, not just its rear strap.
Close around the centered green watch and lift with slight backward clearance from the basket rim; verify retention visually.
Green watch was not retained. Reopen and descend to a deeper grasp, shifting slightly toward the solid case seen on the right.
Close at the observed deeper pose around the green watch, then lift straight up with no rotation to test retention.
Green watch remains on the table. Reopen, shift toward its solid case in the wrist image, and descend for a more centered grasp.
Relieve the low-height tracking residual, move jaws toward the watch case at the bottom of the wrist view, and close without further descent.
The green watch case is now centered in the jaws. Lift vertically to verify retention and confirm the adjacent pen stays on the table.
The watch slipped. Withdraw the left arm and approach from the right with a different, nearly vertical jaw orientation, keeping the arms separated.
Center the right gripper over the green watch from its own side, descending with jaws open and the closing axis roughly left-right.
Target the green watch's solid case with the right jaws, away from the adjacent pen. Close and test a short straight lift.
Objects shifted during closure. Open and withdraw both grippers to obtain a clear view before replanning the remaining watch and pens.
Move the right arm outward to reveal the remaining objects. Approach the black pen with left jaws aligned across its width.
Center left jaws over the black pen shaft and descend. Approach the now-visible green watch with the right arm, maintaining lateral separation.
Close left jaws around the centered black pen and test a straight lift. Recenter the right gripper toward the green watch seen high-left in its wrist image.
Black pen appears held; move it back toward a safe transfer route. Shift right jaws inward and away from the basket wall to center on the green watch.
Carry the black pen to the center-front staging area with left jaws closed. Make a small right alignment correction and test a watch grasp with a vertical lift.
Lower the black pen onto the center-front transfer area. The green watch appears raised; tilt the right gripper gently forward to bring it past the blue rim while retaining reach margin.
Release the black pen on the staging surface and withdraw left. After the right continuity interruption, back away from the blue rim with small increments; the watch is no longer held.
Clear the left arm from the staged black pen. Bring right jaws over its right-hand end, rotating gradually to close across the shaft.
Align right jaws around the staged black pen near its cap, using a small inward tilt while the EE remains on the right side; descend open.
The black pen shaft is centered. Lower a little, close right jaws across it, and lift vertically to verify retention.
Carry the apparently retained black pen toward the red basket with closed jaws, adding a small forward tilt for reach margin.
The black pen stayed on the table. Return the open right gripper to the staging point for a deeper grasp around the shaft.
